caption: Three new Gabby's Dollhouse and Doozie's Doghouse toys and one new show, as we read them on November 23: the Sister Fun Pack is out but Walmart had none in stock, the Puggie Paws plush is a December pre-order (our two sources disagree on the day), the LEGO set is due January 1, 2027, and Makers and Bakers reaches Netflix on December 9 with no toys we could find. Every date with its source: https://everylittleroom.com/guides/new-gabbys-dollhouse-toys?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=short&utm_campaign=answer Independent parents' site, not affiliated with the show. Prices are typical US store prices from our dated checks. As an Amazon Associate we earn from qualifying purchases.
title: New Gabby's Dollhouse toys: what's out, and when? (checked Nov 23)
